# Koschei Lang

> Koschei is a capability-secure programming language. Code cannot touch the disk, network, environment variables or other processes unless it is handed a capability for it, and the compiler lists exactly what a program can touch before it runs. Pre-1.0; free for personal use, 49 USD per developer for commercial use.

Install with `pip install koschei-lang` (Python 3.12+). The `ks` command checks, runs and builds programs; `ks caps` prints a program's capability manifest; `ks caps --deny net` fails a build that asks for network access.

## Try and learn

- [Playground](https://koschei.dev/play): run Koschei in the browser; programs that ask for disk, network or environment access are blocked before they run
- [Language guide](https://github.com/bugsbuny243/koschei-lang/blob/main/docs/guide/LANGUAGE_GUIDE.en.md): every example in it is run by the test suite
- [Security walkthrough](https://koschei.dev/security-guide.html): how capabilities stop a malicious dependency

## For AI agents

- [Koschei for AI agents](https://koschei.dev/agents): run agent-written code under a policy you set once
- [MCP server guide](https://github.com/bugsbuny243/koschei-lang/blob/main/docs/MCP_SERVER.md): `uvx koschei-lang --allow-read /path` starts the MCP server; listed in the official MCP Registry as `io.github.bugsbuny243/koschei`
